RULE: only entries with "verified": true are ever rendered on the site.
A source is verified when a human has opened it and confirmed it actually supports
the claim it is attached to. This flag exists specifically to stop unverified or
AI-suggested citations reaching readers, which AGENTS.md and the product brief forbid.
